description: Cancel an order that has not shipped yet. An authorized payment is released and a captured one is refunded in full; the buyer gets an email. Requires the buyer's approval.

id.description: Order id returned in `order.id` by complete_checkout.

idempotency-key.description: Unique key for retry safety. Maps to HTTP Idempotency-Key header.

ucp-agent.description: Platform agent identification. Maps to HTTP UCP-Agent header.

profile.description: URL to the platform's UCP profile.

name: cancel_order
